work: Created a standalone page for the moving Brighton i360 observation pod. Confirmed current operator site, location, opening calendar, standard adult View 360 fare, accessibility and trip duration; searched official Park and StandaloneAttraction catalogues; imported two exact, visually inspected licensed photographs; verified eight public pages and image binaries; published Facebook.
qualification: Permanent, independently ticketed moving observation tower on Brighton seafront. Brighton Pier is a distinct park and not its parent.

visitorInformation.pricingDecision: Operator advertises standard View 360 adult aged 16+ at GBP 20.50 on experience page checked 2026-11-14. Mode Dynamic minimumAmount because final checkout price and time slot should be verified before payment. No stale child tariff entered.
visitorInformation.hoursDecision: Operator opening-times page generic weekly pod schedule conflicts with dated November plan-your-visit calendar. No evergreen weekly hours entered; visitors directed to live booking calendar.
visitorInformation.accessibility: Step-free pod; up to four wheelchairs per ride; lithium-powered wheelchair restriction and companion ticket on operator FAQ.
visitorInformation.tripDuration: Operator gives 25 minutes; request arrival 20 minutes ahead of booked slot.
